questions.stem: What is the main advantage of hydrogen as a fuel?

options.text: It is the cheapest fuel available
It is easy to store and transport
The only product of its combustion is water, so it produces no CO2 emissions
It is found in large underground reserves

questions.explanation: The main advantage of hydrogen is that burning it produces only water: 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. There are no CO2 emissions when hydrogen is used. However, challenges include storage (hydrogen is very light and needs compression), the energy required for production, and the need for new infrastructure.
